northStar: The Look Back — a black room with one light above the centre; your trade history drawn as terrain, then interrogated until every claim points at a trade.

void.role: page ground; there is no light variant

white.role: primary text, primary action, active proof

loss.role: the single colour; losses, sells, struck citations, errors — data only

elevation.panel: radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% -10%, rgba(255,255,255,0.07), transparent 60%) over linear-gradient(180deg, #0c0c0c, #080808); inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06); 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.9)
elevation.beam: 160px wide, white 22%→5%→0 vertical gradient, blur 18px, clip-path trapezoid

motion.terrain: canvas, continuous drift + pointer parallax, paused off-screen, single frame under reduced motion
motion.breathe: 5s ease-in-out infinite on the mark tile
motion.reveal: animation-timeline: view(); rise 36px + blur 8px; range entry 0% to cover 28%
motion.scan: 1.6s travelling highlight on a hairline while analysing

rules: Emphasis is light — brightness, glow, the beam — never a second colour.
The loss colour lives inside data only.
Graphics are built from real pipeline output; no diagram shows a number the pipeline did not produce.
Cited rows carry a wash, an inset bar and a bolder ID so proof never relies on colour alone.
Headings stand alone: no eyebrow, pill label or kicker above them.
notCanonized: The reference image's pill labels above section headings — a craft-floor ban, deliberately not built.
The reference image's partner logo strip — replaced with measured sample figures, since Hindsight has no partners to claim.
